procedures.title: Rear lamp housing replacement
steps: Refer to figure 21 in the manual for removal and installation of the Corvette rear lamp housings.

procedures.title: License plate lamp housing replacement
steps: Remove the lamp retaining screws and take the lamp off its mounting.
Unplug the lamp lead from the chassis harness connector (inside the trunk on some models).
Where used, push the grommet and lead down through the body opening and remove the lamp.
To install, feed the grommet and lead up through the opening where used and plug into the chassis harness.
Set the lamp in place and fit the screws; on Corvette make sure the ground wire is fitted correctly.

procedures.title: License plate lamp bulb replacement
steps: Remove the lens screws and lens.
